history.content: Hi, my phone has no service at all right now. I can't make calls, send messages, or use the internet.

I can help you troubleshoot your service issue. To get started, I’ll need to identify your account. Could you please provide one of the following:

- The phone number associated with your account
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I can assist you further.
Sure, my name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Thank you for providing your information. Your line status appears to be active, which means there are no suspensions or contract issues on our end.

To help diagnose why you have no service, could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know if you see any of the following:

- Airplane mode icon
- “No Signal” or a signal strength indicator (bars)
- Any other unusual icons

This will help me determine the next steps to restore your service.
I see a 'No Signal' icon in the status bar, but it also says 'Data Enabled' and 'Connected to Chestnut-5G.' Still, nothing is working—no calls, messages, or internet.

Thank you for the details. Seeing “No Signal” means your phone isn’t connecting to the cellular network, even though mobile data is enabled and you’re connected to Wi-Fi. Let’s proceed with some troubleshooting steps:

1. Please check if Airplane Mode is enabled on your phone. If it is, turn it off.
2. If Airplane Mode is off, the next step is to check your SIM card status. Could you check your SIM card status and let me know if it shows as “Active,” “Missing,” or “Locked”?

This information will help me guide you further.
I checked the SIM card status and it shows as 'active.' Airplane mode is off, but I still have no signal and nothing is working.

Thank you for confirming that your SIM card is active and Airplane Mode is off. Since your line is active and your SIM card is recognized, the next common cause could be incorrect network settings, specifically the APN (Access Point Name) settings.

Could you please check your APN settings and let me know if they appear correct or if there’s any error or missing information (such as the MMSC URL)? This will help determine if a reset is needed.
My APN settings show the APN name as 'fast.telecom.net', but the status says 'Not set'. The MMSC URL is filled in. Is that normal?

Thank you for checking. If the APN status says “Not set,” even though the MMSC URL is filled in, this could indicate an issue with your APN configuration, which can prevent your phone from connecting to the cellular network.

Let’s try resetting your APN settings to the default. Please use the option on your phone to reset APN settings. After you reset, you’ll need to reboot your device for the changes to take effect.

Once you’ve done both steps (reset APN settings and reboot your phone), let me know if your service returns or if you still see “No Signal.”
I already reset the APN settings and rebooted my phone as you asked. After restarting, I still see 'No Signal' and nothing is working.
YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.

arguments.summary: Customer Sofia Martinez has no cellular service ('No Signal') despite line and SIM being active, Airplane Mode off, APN reset, and device rebooted. Needs advanced technical support.
